question: What further omens accompany the rite when an unknown person speaks or lost property appears?
premises: Unknown person conversation is listed as an omen.
Lost property arising is listed as an omen.
Tathā adds another item to the list.
inference: The verse extends the catalogue of ritual omens.
uncertainties: The exact auspicious or inauspicious value of each omen is not stated in this excerpt.
plain_english: Also, conversation with an unknown person and the arising of lost property.
